test ステップに continue-on-error を設定します。

files..github/workflows/test.yml:
name: test
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      - name: test
        run: go test ./...
        continue-on-error: true
